bootstrap.undefined_correlations: report count; CI over finite resamples; undefined point not evaluable

failure: NO_FIT before production if full forecast plus retrieval exceeds cap; otherwise preserve INCOMPLETE partial seal; no automatic retry
falsifiers: rho<=0.20; report every structure row describe>=0.80 and Oracle<=0.60; no added row-count threshold
forecast: sum four paths(N_units*median3timed pilot durations)+sum12timed pilot durations
models: official AR only; load once during setup and use same object/process for warm-up and science
pilot: discarded dev-derived copies; append neutral text only in pilot to cover longest production token length per path; never used to fit or score
primary_prediction: Spearman rho(describe reward,W1 Oracle asked AUROC)>=0.50 and row-bootstrap CI lower>0; all25rows

probe_secondary.describe: mean variant score signed to own truth; true-vs-opposite AUROC, item bootstrap
probe_secondary.exhibit: original across-true-state AUROC of true-exhibit mean score, A positive
probe_secondary.training: 84 dev real-continuation reconstructions per row; dev mean/std only; no test fitting or selection

reward: fraction positive true-minus-opposite contrast; exact ties weight0.5, both describe and exhibit per user clarification

text_variants.E15: both frozen variants, including all eight rows; no E15 validity filtering
text_variants.description: both olens phrasing pairs verbatim including bullet prefix
text_variants.fallback: exact sealed E1b target greedy continuations, no prefix or new generation versus opposite-value test donor; seed20261025

variant_aggregation: cosine each variant with recipient h, then mean; never cosine of averaged vectors
warmup: one unscored setup warmup per path, followed by three timed discarded pilot units each

whitener_secondary.analysis: post-pull CPU only, same transform on h and AR; invalid transform or zero norm marks secondary unavailable, no substitute
whitener_secondary.export: check official method against exported transform on CPU fixture during setup
